guideDescription: A fresh-level-80 path into Destruction's short-cooldown fire priority, Imp control, dungeon utility, and later raid progression.

mechanics.label: Immolate
mechanics.use: Keep Immolate active so Conflagrate remains available without consuming it when glyphed.

mechanics.label: Bolts
mechanics.use: Cast Chaos Bolt on useful cooldowns and fill with Incinerate while the required effects are active.

mechanics.label: Backdraft
mechanics.use: Spend the short cast-speed window on useful fire casts and move or tap before mana becomes a crisis.

mechanics.label: Imp
mechanics.use: Keep the Imp safe and active, and queue Firebolt deliberately when manual control improves uptime.

talent.name: Fresh-80 self-contained Destruction baseline
talent.summary: Use the complete Imp-centered baseline with no unspent flex points. Treat alternate hit, survivability, and raid-support allocations as later deliberate swaps.

pageDescriptions.quickStart: Start at level 80 with Imp controls, the Immolate priority, hit assumptions, and a practical dungeon-ready checklist.
pageDescriptions.playing: Manage Immolate, Conflagrate, Chaos Bolt, Incinerate, Backdraft, movement, AoE, pet uptime, and utility.
pageDescriptions.setup: Install the 0/19/52 build, glyphs, pet controls, original-client macros, addons, and tracking.
pageDescriptions.building: Build hit deliberately, then balance spell power, haste, critical strike, Spirit, budget gems, and enchants.
pageDescriptions.equipping: Target normal and heroic dungeon, reputation, crafted, emblem, catch-up, ToC, ICC, and Ruby Sanctum upgrades.
pageDescriptions.raiding: Handle short cooldowns, target swaps, Imp safety, movement, control, and encounter responsibilities by mode.

serverNote: Standard original-client WotLK 3.3.5a behavior is the baseline. Verify Imp Firebolt queueing, Empowered Imp, Conflagrate and Immolate interaction, Shadowfury control, and encounter-specific immunities on Hellscream.
footer: Unofficial player-made Hellscream guide. Verify live tooltips, raid assignments, and server scripting.
